description: RbNa₃Mo₂H₁₈O₁₇ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃/m space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two RbNa₃Mo₂H₁₈O₁₇ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. Rb is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Rb-O bond lengths are 3.03 Å. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MoO₄ tetrahedra and faces with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.49 Å. Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 50°. There is one shorter (1.78 Å) and three longer (1.81 Å) Mo-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Rb, one Na, and two H atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three equivalent Na and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Mo atom.
